task: BBBC054 microglial MORPHOLOGY CLASS (not activation state)
dataset_note: Replicate 1 annotates all THREE classes - round, ramified and amoeboid - contrary to the premise of review finding D5b and PLAN_v1.md F3.2.1 that only two of three are present. The three-class task is primary; the two-class round-vs-amoeboid contrast is also reported for comparability with v0.
um_per_px_provenance: Leica DMI 6000 with a 20x objective and an Andor AND-DG-152V-C1E-FI camera (BBBC054 page). The Andor Neo 5.5 sCMOS specification gives 2560 x 2160 at 6.5 um pixel pitch; these images are 1080 x 1280 = exactly half in each axis, i.e. 2x2 binning, so the pixel size is 2 x 6.5 / 20 = 0.65 um/px, equal to the common target (resample factor 1.0). The camera model code could not be confirmed by name, so a scale-sensitivity analysis is also reported.
e5_frame_shuffle: N/A: BBBC054 is static, so there is no temporal order to destroy. E5 applies only to tracking and forecasting.
seed_varies: a different stratified cell subsample, a different StratifiedGroupKFold fold assignment, and for E6 a different random-init draw (PLAN_v1.md F3.5)

E1_handcrafted_improved.note: segmentation + shape + Zernike + Haralick on the mask; probed with logistic regression and a random forest, better reported (fixes C6)
